note: Metres. X runs from Arjuna (negative) to Karna (positive), cameras sit on the -Y side, Z is up. 36 mm sensor width.

A01.card: Extreme close-up, locked off, then a 6-frame snap zoom out
A01.action: A blue lightning arrowhead and a gold sun-fire arrowhead meet point to point in the center of a black frame and burst.

A02.card: Extreme wide, 24mm, eye level, slow push-in
A02.action: Two chariots face each other across a cleared ring of red earth while two halted armies watch.

A03.card: Medium close-up, 85mm, slight low angle, slow push-in
A03.action: Karna touches his bow to his forehead, then his eyes lift to screen left.

A04.card: Medium close-up, 85mm, mirror of A03, slow push-in
A04.action: Arjuna draws Gandiva and blue static crawls up the bow.

A05.card: Low tracking shot at wheel height, 18mm, fast dolly
A05.action: Krishna flicks the reins and the white horses surge forward.

A06.card: Arrow-cam: camera launches with the arrows, 35mm, then whip-pan
A06.action: Karna looses a fan of seven arrows in one draw.

A07.card: Medium wide, 35mm, camera shake on each hit
A07.action: Arjuna's arrows split Karna's arrows in mid-air, one by one.

A08.card: Crane up from ground to high top-down, 24mm
A08.action: The sky fills with so many arrows that they blot out the sun.

A09.card: Split-screen two-shot, both 85mm close-ups, locked off
A09.action: In the arrow-darkness the two warriors, exhausted, look at each other.

A10.action: Karna draws a single arrow from a golden quiver; its head is a serpent's mouth and its eye opens.

A11.action: Karna draws the snake arrow to his ear and meteors fall from a red sky.

A12.action: The snake arrow tears across the sky, splitting it with a line of fire.

A13.card: Low angle on the chariot floor, 18mm, then a hard drop
A13.action: Krishna presses his foot down and the chariot sinks a cubit into the earth; the horses kneel.

A14.card: Medium close-up, 50mm, speed ramp 100 to 10 to 100 percent
A14.action: The snake arrow strikes Arjuna's crown off instead of his head.

A15.action: Arjuna rises and binds his hair with a white cloth.

A16.action: Karna's left wheel sinks; he leaps down and heaves it, and the whole earth lifts a little.

A17.card: Over-the-shoulder from Arjuna to Karna, 50mm, one 12-frame insert
A17.action: Karna raises a palm to ask Arjuna to wait; Krishna's look answers with a memory of Abhimanyu.

A18.action: Arjuna's razor arrow cuts Karna's gold banner and it falls across the sun.

A19.card: Wide to extreme close-up, one continuous push, 24mm to 135mm feel
A19.action: Arjuna draws the Anjalika and rings of lightning ripple out from Gandiva.

A20.card: Impact frames, then a locked wide silhouette
A20.action: The Anjalika flies; Karna's silhouette stands against the sun as the sun goes dark.

A21.action: A column of light rises from where Karna fell and enters the sun.

A22.card: Medium wide, 50mm, locked off, hold the final pose
A22.action: Arjuna lowers Gandiva and does not celebrate; Krishna watches the light.
